brief_title: Effect of Proliverenol on Liver Fat and Insulin Resistance in Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Open Label Evaluator Blind,The Effect of Proliverenol Supplementation on the Visceral Adiposity Index, HOMA-IR, C-Peptide, and Controlled Attenuation Parameter (CAP) in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes at Dr. Mohammad Hoesin General Hospital in Palembang.

arm_groups.label: Proliverenol Supplementation 1000 mg with standard Therapy of DM
Patients receive standard of care treatment only

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in the Visceral Adiposity Index (VAI) from baseline to week 12
Change in HOMA-IR from baseline to week 12
Change in C-Peptide from baseline to week 12
Change in Controlled Attenuation Parameter (CAP) from baseline to week 12

brief_summary: This study aims to determine whether Proliverenol supplementation can improve liver fat levels and blood sugar control in patients with type 2 diabetes. Participants will be divided into two groups: one group will receive Proliverenol with standar therapy of DM, and the other only receive standar therapy of DM. The study will last for 12 weeks, and participants will undergo blood tests and liver examinations."

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes
* VAI values: women \> 0.705, men \> 1.48, or CAP values ≥ 236
* Ages 30-65 years
* Receiving standard Type 2 diabetes treatment for at least 3 months with HbA1c levels between 7% and 9.5%.
* Willing to participate in the study by signing an informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Taking long-term steroid medication, either oral or systemic.
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women
* History of or currently suffering from an autoimmune disease
* History of or previous infection with hepatitis B or C
* ALT/AST levels \> 2x ULN, eGFR \< 60, or unstable heart disease.
* Regular alcohol consumption
